next_step: Start 2-week POC: reranker hosted endpoint + offline eval set
notes:
Topline: mid-market product analytics vendor exploring Redwood for reranking pipeline. Initially trialing Hosted API reranker endpoint; target is to move to Dedicated pool if latency/consistency and unit economics look good.

Recent touchpoints:
- 2025-11-05 discovery call (Jordan, Priya): described current infra (GCP) and usage patterns. baseline ~10M Qs/mo, peak 200 qps. p95 latency target 150ms for reranker.
- 2025-11-12 demo: showed hosted reranker prototype, streaming vs batch options. J. Gomez (engineering lead) asked about offline scoring and how to run large evals.
- 2025-11-18 recorded deep-dive (fireflies ff_20251118_vgw-call). Priya walked through integration steps; team liked the eval harness idea.
- 2025-11-22 security questionnaire submitted; flagged KMS + residency questions. Redwood security FAQ shared (drive/Shared/verdant/Redwood_PRICING_v2.pdf).
- 2025-11-29 follow-up call: procurement asked for 3-node dedicated pricing and SLA language. Redwood pricing deck linked.
- 2025-12-01 sync: confirmed evaluation criteria and POC metrics.

Use-case & technical reqs (from SE calls):
- Primary: reranking endpoint to re-score candidate lists produced by current retrieval layer. Need per-query pairwise scores and ability to return top-K with scores.
- Offline scoring: must be able to run batch scoring on 50k-200k candidate pairs for offline evals and retraining pipelines.
- Eval sets: they have ~50k labeled pairs, want Redwood to run head-to-head A/B with baseline model and produce per-query MRR/NDCG and sample-level diffs.
- Latency/throughput: p95 <= 150ms for single-query rerank at expected top-K=100, throughput for live stage ~150-200 qps.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit if dedicated shows 30-40% cost savings vs hosted at scale.
- Model preferences: prefer open checkpoint variants; interested in quantized variants if quality preserved. Want automatic fallback policy (cheaper model) when capacity constrained.
- Security: SSO (SAML), audit logs retained 1 year, KMS integration required, and EU data residency for a subset of users.

POC plan (agreed):
- Week 0: service account & VPC peering + security questionnaire response (Priya).
- Week 1: ingest eval set, Redwood team will run offline scoring job & produce NDCG baseline.
- Week 2: integrate hosted reranker endpoint into canary path for 10% traffic -> monitor latency, cost, and quality.
- Week 3: decision point: proceed to Dedicated pricing/contract or iterate.

Quotes/voice of customer: "If we can get consistent p95 under 150ms and lower unit cost, we can standardize on Redwood for rerank." — J. Gomez (ENG). Procurement: "Need committed pricing for 3-node pool and SLAs; legal wants data residency clause."

Open items / blockers: security sign-off on KMS flow (security team wants architecture diagram), procurement needs committed pricing, need small integration sample from their Java service (engineering to provide infra access).

Next steps (short): Priya to share POC checklist + small Java SDK example by 2025-12-03. Redwood to run initial offline scoring on provided eval-set (drive/Shared/verdant/eval-sets/2025-11-09.zip) and share results by 2025-12-09. Procurement follow-up scheduled 2025-12-10.
